basics.name: Rogério do Carmo
basics.label: Senior Mobile React Native Developer
basics.summary: Senior Mobile Front-End Developer with 5+ years building cross-platform mobile applications, specializing in React Native for the banking and fintech sector. Experienced delivering critical features such as complete Pix (DICT) modules, biometric authentication, and loan flows for financial institutions across Latin America. Holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science and an M.Sc. in Cartographic Sciences from UNESP.

work.name: Topaz
work.summary: Development and maintenance of mobile applications for financial institutions, focusing on critical features and user experience for the company's internal banking product.
highlights: Developed and implemented a complete Pix module for banking applications, including integration with DICT (Directory of Transactional Account Identifiers)
Implemented biometric login with Daon integration for secure authentication
Created a loan module with a complete request and approval flow
Delivered projects for clients including CrediSIS (Brazil), Bradescard (Mexico), Banco Macro (Argentina), and Banco do Nordeste - BNB (Brazil)
Implemented unit tests with Jest and used monitoring tools (Elastic, Kibana, Grafana) for performance analysis
Managed app distribution via Google Play Console, Apple Developer, and TestFlight, and mentored junior developers in React Native best practices

work.name: Rubcube
work.summary: Developed the mobile application for client Banco Digi+, focusing on banking features and user experience.
highlights: Created a complete Pix module from scratch for Banco Digi+, including all transfer and payment functionalities
Developed React Native components in both functional and class formats
Integrated REST APIs for banking services and worked with MongoDB for data persistence
Developed the company website using React JS

work.name: Rubcube
work.summary: Worked on the Virtus Pay mobile application, focusing on maintenance and code quality.
highlights: Performed maintenance and bug fixes on the Virtus Pay application
Worked with Flutter for cross-platform development of digital payment applications

work.name: Engeselt
work.summary: Built a GNSS (GPS) proof of concept for master's research, then worked on proprietary products for the electrical sector.
highlights: Developed a proof of concept using GNSS (GPS) data from master's research
Implemented offline-first features with SQFlite and OpenStreetMaps
Worked with Flutter and MobX for state management, and developed in native Android using Java and XML
